summary: Summit Therapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K on September 13, 2026, disclosing a press release noting that partner Akeso announced updated overall survival data from the Phase III HARMONi-2 trial of ivonescimab versus pembrolizumab in PD-L1-positive advanced NSCLC, presented at WCLC 2026 in Seoul. No corporate transaction, shareholder action, or structural event is involved; the filing is an ordinary disclosure of clinical data via Items 8.01 and 9.01 with Exhibit 99.1. No merger, tender, spin-off, activist, restructuring, or capital-return element exists. The only angle for traders is binary clinical read-through risk to SMMT shares around the September 15 presentation.
